requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests validating that sponsor data transformation correctly maps raw sponsor name, type, funding source, collaborators, and score contribution into display-ready fields.
The system must include unit tests verifying normalization of funding source values into the allowed set (public, private, undisclosed).
The system must include unit tests validating correct formatting of multiple collaborators into a displayable list or string.
The system must include unit tests verifying that score contribution text is correctly derived from input data.
The system must include UI tests confirming that the sponsor name is rendered in the MessageBubble component when provided.
The system must include UI tests confirming that sponsor type and funding source are rendered correctly in the sponsor credibility block.
The system must include UI tests validating that multiple collaborators are displayed correctly and in the expected format.
The system must include UI tests confirming that score contribution is visible and correctly positioned within the sponsor credibility block.
The system must include a test case where funding source is missing and verify that a default value (e.g., 'undisclosed') is rendered.
The system must include a test case where collaborators are absent and verify that the UI handles the absence without rendering errors or empty placeholders.
The system must include a test ensuring that malformed or partial sponsor data does not cause runtime errors in the transformation logic.
The system must include a UI test verifying that the sponsor credibility component does not render when no sponsor data is provided.
The system must ensure all new unit and UI tests pass in the existing frontend test suite without regressions.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both happy path scenarios and at least two edge cases (missing funding source and multiple collaborators).
